name: @pipeworx/mcp-askdata-xk

tools.name: subjects
tools.description: Browse the Kosovo Agency of Statistics (ASKdata) PxWeb subject tree. Default path 'ASKdata' returns top-level folders (type 'l') and tables (type 't', '.px' suffix). Supply a deeper sub-path like 'ASKdata/Prices/Consumer Price Index' to drill into a subject area.

path.description: Sub-path (default "ASKdata" = top database). e.g. "ASKdata/Prices/Consumer Price Index".

tools.name: table_meta
tools.description: Fetch dimension definitions and valid coded values for a Kosovo ASKdata PxWeb table. Path must be the full path ending in '.px' (e.g. 'ASKdata/Prices/Consumer Price Index/Annual indicators/T4CPI.px'). Returns dimensions and value lists — required to build a valid query_table body.

tools.name: query_table
tools.description: POST a PxWeb query to a Kosovo ASKdata table and return observations as json-stat2. body must be {query:[{code, selection:{filter,values}}], response:{format:'json-stat2'}}. PxWeb caps responses at ~10,000 cells — use codes from table_meta to narrow selections across dimensions.

instructions: @pipeworx/mcp-askdata-xk forwards to the Pipeworx gateway and lists only the askdata-xk pack's tools. Set PIPEWORX_META_TOOLS=1 to also list ask_pipeworx and the other gateway-wide tools.
